<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Outlook:</strong> Analysts and research firms anticipate a potential 25 bps repo rate hike in the upcoming October MPC meeting, driven by sticky inflation and rising crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNdUhEeHNZVlMxMTVydnNHZjA5R2V3aTNnUGZ4dUtCNjVvU2Z5OXdfZkNlZHlVNklvbTQzMTAtQUR1QWxzdnN6ZTAxQU1ZOWI4ZDA5ZGFoZnc4TlVydTFVY3h3UE9BWGx3MnNmcWVoZjAyV0xSYnF5VDF4czh3VmxuYVVrTXAtUGp2X2pnYnhQMk1ScG5fWjR6dHJVMlpkQjhJQ1hB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Downturn:</strong> Indian equities have extended their losing streak to eight consecutive weeks, with significant wealth erosion and Nifty nearing 52-week lows as FIIs continue to exit the market.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxOckJEMEtFUTYtLXN4WVA3R1IyaUJwZFRpb0dvRzVIbG5VOS1KYjhiM21QUGtxak9ibWhsWFJCSlRFQVRGMTktUW5Hc1NOa0RmWUhVOS1oajU4UFBmOUtmTnZmS0w3MGppamI4N0ZBRFA5NHpKQ0pYaE9PWjdBS0ZiV2xYSl9UcTdBSmhNaWZQWHFVanYzazcxWFk2eWNjQ1dJOUxkOXVuUi1VU3B5NnhUTk1RYmdpVGczQUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Earnings and Growth:</strong> Recent data indicates that Nifty earnings are currently lagging behind GDP growth, contributing to broader market weakness and investor caution.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>External Stability:</strong> While FCNR inflows have provided some cushion to the rupee, sustained external stability remains heavily dependent on a reversal in FII flows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNUW56eENRTkNyVDhueHpJZDRMNlFlQTlrQncxVEszTnJINDdCclJKdERzUkpsZUhUeXV4cy13XzFIaGZuSVlaUHk2bGJpVmplTmJZUW1rNENSTTFfTjNoLTBQOHhmS2Z2d3ExWThNSnNXRzJWUi1lVy1EWnFMVzBnNGtidjJRbkZKSDhrcmlibVpWVUVjR25oc0JGQ2VsMy00Zi1vLV81RU9EdXlUWUlpclNJYw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Crude Oil Impact:</strong> Kotak has raised its FY27 crude oil price forecast to $90 per barrel, heightening concerns over inflation and the potential impact on OMCs and the domestic economy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
